title: Movement Verbs with Allative: jön, megy, fordul

sections.content:
Allative pronouns pair with verbs of approach and arrival:
- **jön / megy [hozzá]**: *Mikor jössz hozzánk?* (When are you coming to our place?)
- **fordul [hozzá]**: *Fordulj hozzá kérdéssel!* (Turn to him with a question!)
- **tartozik [hozzá]**: *Ez a könyv hozzá tartozik.* (This book belongs to him/it.)

items.english: Will you come over to my place for a coffee?
You can come over to our place anytime.
